classification.analysis: Starmer resigned after internal rebellion; Andy Burnham took over as PM in late July 2026. Labour has regained narrow polling lead over Reform UK for first time in over a year, but remains 7.7 points below 2024 election result. Reform consolidated from 14% to 24% during Starmer's troubled tenure. Burnham's honeymoon providing temporary stabilization.

Merz's grand coalition has collapsed in polls, falling to just 32% combined while AfD surges to 28% and leads nationally. With only 28% of Germans satisfied with his government and critical state elections in Saxony-Anhalt imminent where AfD may win outright, the chancellor faces severe erosion just 16 months into office.

Macron faces acute crisis as Le Pen commands 35% for 2027 election while his approval collapsed to 19%. Prime Minister Bayrou faces likely-fatal confidence vote September 8th. Election season erupted with bitter debates among seven presidential candidates at August business conference, signaling centrist collapse amid far-right surge.

Sánchez faces existential crisis after August Ceuta migration disaster saw 80,000 migrants enter from Morocco, provoking EU condemnation and Schengen suspension threats. Corruption scandals engulfing his family compound pressure. PP-Vox bloc commands 50% in polls versus government's 36%, projecting 190-seat majority. Coalition down 5 points since 2023 election while Vox surges.

Frederiksen leads caretaker government after March 2026 election delivered historic losses: Social Democrats won just 21.9%, lowest since 1903. Coalition lost parliamentary majority, falling from 50.1% to 39.6%. Danish People's Party surged but remains secondary opposition. Recent week saw Frederiksen addressing sexist social media commentary while managing EU Council Presidency priorities on energy and climate policy.

Despite Labor's historic 2025 landslide victory with 94 seats, One Nation has surged from 6% to 27% primary support, recently overtaking Labor in some polls. The Coalition opposition Andrew Bragg faced backlash for suggesting low-income Australians accept substandard housing. Consumer confidence has deteriorated sharply. Labor maintains two-party preferred leads but faces unprecedented far-right momentum.

classification.cci_source: Irish Credit Union Consumer Sentiment Index
classification.analysis: Martin's coalition has fallen to 36% from 42.7% at election amid fuel protests and cost-of-living pressures. Consumer confidence dropped sharply following Iran war energy price spike. Ireland assumed EU presidency in July, elevating Martin's profile. Uniquely, no far-right party threatens; Sinn Féin provides mainstream opposition. Governing competently but mid-term fatigue evident.

Jetten's minority coalition faces severe headwinds six months in. Consumer confidence plummeted sharply in spring 2026, with most voters expecting government collapse. Coalition polling has dropped 18 points since the October election. However, The Hague announced major NATO defense commitments in Ankara, and the far-right PVV remains fragmented and contained below 15% after the Schoof experiment failed.

Montenegro's coalition has plummeted from 31% to 25% while Chega consolidates at 24%, effectively tying the government. Consumer confidence hit two-year lows following Storm Kristin crisis mismanagement that forced a ministerial resignation. Immigration legislation passed with Chega support signals growing far-right influence over policy direction.

Progress Party surged to 30% in polls, overtaking Labour's 22.6%, reversing their September 2025 election result. Consumer confidence deteriorated to -9.4 in Q1 2026. King Harald V's death on August 28 dominated recent news as Støre navigates national mourning amid declining political support and persistent inflation above target.

Takaichi's LDP-JIP coalition commands a historic two-thirds supermajority after February's landslide victory. Consumer confidence at seven-year highs supports her position. Far-right Sanseito remains marginal at 3% despite growth. September cabinet reshuffle and fiscal debates over sales tax suspension create modest political tension despite her strong mandate.

Michal's coalition lost its parliamentary majority in August 2026 after MP defections, while polling shows catastrophic collapse from 54% to 27%. Consumer confidence remains deeply negative at -32.5 points. The government faces fiscal pressure, prompting gambling tax reviews. Opposition surge led by center-right Isamaa (26.5%), not far-right EKRE (13.8%), which has declined since 2023.

Kristersson's coalition trails opposition ahead of Sept 13 election, down from 49.6% in 2022 to 46.6% now. Sweden Democrats remain key support party at 19.2%. Rift in Tidö cooperation intensifies pressure. Recent school sword attack killed teenager, highlighting law-and-order concerns. Macron visit strengthened defense ties. Consumer confidence improved but coalition defeat appears imminent.

Orpo governs with far-right Finns Party holding Finance Ministry. Coalition down 5 points from 2023 election to 38% as SDP leads at 24%. Government pursuing harsh immigration restrictions and austerity despite €12.9bn deficit. Finns Party gaining while NCP collapses to 17%. Elections April 2027.

Mitsotakis faces mounting pressure with support dropping from 40.8% to 27.5%, while 65% say Greece moves in wrong direction. Tsipras launched new ELAS party in May, activist Karystianou formed anti-corruption party, fragmenting opposition. Greek Solution remains steady at 8.5% but not dominant threat. Cost-of-living concerns persist despite economic growth.

Stocker's historic three-party coalition has collapsed in polls, down from 56.5% at election to 43.6% now, while FPÖ surged to 37.6%. Inflation hit 4.1% in August amid austerity talks. Coalition speculation about former Chancellor Kurz's return fuels internal ÖVP tensions. Consumer confidence deteriorated sharply. The coalition would lose its majority if elections were held today.

De Wever's Arizona coalition governs with stable 57% majority despite consumer confidence falling from -1 to -7. Vlaams Belang polls second nationally but remains cordoned off. Recent India visit signals active governance on trade and defense, though economic sentiment and far-right presence create mild mid-term headwinds.

Luxon survived his second confidence vote in August 2026 after Defence Minister Chris Penk launched a destabilizing leadership challenge. National has collapsed to 31% from 39% at election, though coalition partners ACT and NZ First have gained, keeping the government at 49%. Labour remains weak at 24%, unable to capitalize on government troubles.

Meloni's far-right coalition polls at 40% versus 43% in 2022, below majority threshold. Consumer confidence has declined 2.3 points year-over-year. She campaigned personally for a justice system referendum in March, demonstrating continued institutional reform efforts. Coalition partners Lega and Forza Italia have weakened significantly since taking power.

Babiš's coalition with far-right SPD has lost 5 points since the October 2025 election. In late August, parliament overrode President Pavel's veto of budget legislation, with Pavel criticizing the government for dismissing his objections. Opposition slammed Babiš's drought-prevention pledge as inadequate compared to the previous government's six-times-larger allocation. Consumer confidence has dipped slightly from December inauguration levels.

Trump faces historic disapproval heading into 2026 midterms, with support collapsing to 33-38% amid tariff-driven inflation concerns. Economic sanctions strategy against Iran follows failed military strikes. Republican base erosion accelerates as independent approval hits 34%, below 2018 wave threshold. Supreme Court ballroom ruling provides minor reprieve amid broader institutional tensions.

Magyar completed his first 100 days implementing rule-of-law and anti-corruption reforms while restoring EU relations. Consumer confidence declined in August after a six-month rally, dropping 4 points as economic sentiment cooled. The government faces pressure to unlock 16 billion euros in frozen EU funds by end-August deadline while maintaining overwhelming parliamentary supermajority.

Fico's coalition has collapsed from 43% to 29% in polls as fiscal austerity bites. Consumer confidence hit three-year lows amid tax hikes and wage freezes. Mass protests continue against institutional dismantling. October 2026 local elections loom as critical test. Economy deteriorating with subdued 1% growth projected.

Milei's approval has plummeted to 37% amid slowing economic recovery and corruption scandals involving his Cabinet chief. Growth forecasts were slashed to 2.7% as the labor market crisis persists. Consumer confidence declined sharply to 40 points. He maintains a 30-33% loyal base ahead of 2027 re-election bid despite widespread dissatisfaction.

Netanyahu's far-right coalition faces electoral collapse, with Likud plunging from 32 to 19-22 seats in polls. Former war cabinet member Eisenkot's new party leads opposition to 57 seats versus coalition's 48. Otzma Yehudit grew to 9 seats as controversial death penalty law passed in March. New nationalist splinter party Winter threatens to further fracture right-wing bloc ahead of October 27 election.

Erdoğan faces mounting pressure as opposition New Party leads AKP by 8 points. Imprisonment of Istanbul mayor İmamoğlu sparked largest protests in years. June 2026 judicial package criminalizing LGBTQ+ community intensifies authoritarian consolidation. Consumer confidence improving but regime showing late-stage stress with judicial manipulation to weaken opposition. Geopolitical wins mask domestic fragility.

Tusk's coalition has fragmented following Third Way's June 2025 dissolution, with support sliding from 53.7% to 44.6%. Confederation has surged to 15.3%, more than doubling since 2023. Recent tensions include thwarting a Russian assassination plot and ongoing conflicts with President Nawrocki, who won in 2025. Economic growth remains strong but political cohesion deteriorates.

Carney swept all three August 31 by-elections, securing majority status. His confrontational stance against Trump's 50% tariffs has boosted approval to 60%, rallying nationalist sentiment. The far-right PPC remains marginal at 2%, while Liberals poll 3 points above their historic 2025 election result. Consumer confidence has stabilized after Q1 weakness.

Lee's approval plunged to 40.2% after six consecutive weeks of decline, marking his lowest rating since taking office. Housing policy failures drove 27% of disapproval for a fourth straight week, while security concerns over scaled-back US military exercises and judicial disputes compound political pressure. Consumer confidence fell from February's 8-year high of 112.1 to 104.5 in August.

Sheinbaum's approval dropped to 64% from 70% at inauguration as governing realities bite. August 2026 crisis involved Sinaloa governor facing U.S. drug charges briefly returning to office before backlash forced second leave. She proposed constitutional reform barring dual nationals from presidency. Consumer confidence declined from October 2024 peak as Phase IV honeymoon fades.
